_about: The publication's writers: Meet our writers (writers.html) and each writer's own page (writer-<slug>.html), both written by tools/pages/build.mjs (npm run pages) from this file, content/team.json and src/publication/pieces-data.js.

Each writer: id; name, exactly as printed on their pieces (their pieces are found by it); slug, their page's address; team, their id in content/team.json where they are on the core team (their photo and intro come from there unless their own are given here); photo, a WebP from the site's root (assets/writers/ or assets/team/), or null; intro, their introduction as paragraphs, or null; short, two or three sentences cut from their own introduction (never new words), shown over their photo on Meet our writers when it is pointed at, or null; first (optional), the name to call them by where it is not the first word of their name.

awaiting: what has not come in yet. Until it does, a placeholder stands in: the publication's mark on a tile in the colour of their first piece, and 'Their introduction is on its way'. Send the photo (4:5, as the team's) to assets/writers/<slug>.webp and put it, the intro and its short version here, then take 'awaiting' away.

writers.name: Aripra Sharma
writers.short: whirlwind (n): a rush of chaos and momentum. Hi! I'm Aripra:) I joined this collective not purely because of my love for theatre, but because I wanted to take all that chaos and actually put it towards something meaningful.

writers.name: Aadi Ramnani
writers.short: Hi, I’m Aadi and I’ve been training in theatre since kindergarten. Theatre has been a huge part of my life, partly because it lets me explore different versions of my own self, those that I never would have dared touch in reality.

writers.name: Anika Megha Kruthiventi
intro: Hi, I’m Anika. I’m curious about almost everything, which is probably why I’m always doing three things at once. I love science, especially the little “why” behind things, but I also love writing, creating and turning random ideas into actual projects. I’m naturally quite curious and probably ask too many questions, but I think that’s how I learn best. I’m still figuring out where all these interests will take me, but I’m having fun finding out.

writers.name: Kodela Gautam
writers.short: Hey there! I’m Gautam, a DP 1 student and this year’s Head of Publication for the Drama Collective. As a student, I am a person who enjoys putting thoughts into words that can be remembered for a lifetime.
